headerDisplay: Control Superfan smart fans from Apple Home. Unofficial; not affiliated with Superfan or KIOT. Sign in with the email and password you use in the My Superfan app.

pollInterval.title: Status check interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often each fan is asked for its state, so changes from the remote or the app show up in Home.

deviceId.title: Fan device ID
deviceId.description: The 12-character ID shown in the Homebridge log (e.g. from the fan's network name fan_<deviceId>).

host.title: Fixed IP address
host.description: Use when the fan cannot be found automatically (e.g. Homebridge in Docker without host networking).
